gaps.title: Real-time labor data integration for career matching
gaps.pain: Students choose careers without knowing actual salaries, employability, or demand in Peru, leading to high mismatch and unemployment.
gaps.why_now: No existing tool combines psychometric tests with live labor market data; government portals are static and hard to use.
gaps.evidence_needed: Survey showing >70% of students lack labor market info; pilot with 100 students measuring decision confidence.
gaps.risk: Data acquisition and maintenance costs; need partnerships with government and universities.

gaps.title: Conversational AI agent for personalized guidance
gaps.pain: Students rely on generic tests or expensive counselors; no interactive, always-available tool that adapts to individual profiles.
gaps.why_now: ChatGPT lacks Peru-specific data; existing chatbots are not specialized for career guidance.
gaps.evidence_needed: User testing showing higher engagement with conversational agent vs. static tests; retention metrics.
gaps.risk: NLP accuracy for Spanish and local slang; user trust in AI recommendations.

gaps.title: University and location-based recommendations
gaps.pain: Students often choose universities far from home or with poor job placement; no tool factors in location and university quality.
gaps.why_now: Current tools ignore geographic constraints and university-specific outcomes; students waste time and money.
gaps.evidence_needed: Data on drop-out rates due to location mismatch; case studies of students who benefited from location-aware advice.
gaps.risk: Requires comprehensive university database; privacy concerns with location data.

gaps.title: Affordable, scalable alternative to private counselors
gaps.pain: Private career coaching costs $50-200/session, inaccessible to most Peruvian families; school counselors are overworked.
gaps.why_now: Digital solution can serve thousands at low cost; no competitor offers data-driven guidance at this price point.
gaps.evidence_needed: Price sensitivity analysis; willingness-to-pay survey among target users.
gaps.risk: Low willingness to pay if free alternatives exist; need to demonstrate value clearly.

gaps.title: Integration with school curriculum and government programs
gaps.pain: Career guidance is not systematically integrated into schools; students lack structured exposure to career planning.
gaps.why_now: Government initiatives like 'Ponte en Carrera' exist but are underutilized; schools need easy-to-use digital tools.
gaps.evidence_needed: Pilot with 5 schools showing improved career readiness; feedback from school counselors.
gaps.risk: Bureaucratic hurdles; slow adoption in public schools.

gaps.title: Post-graduation tracking and alumni network
gaps.pain: Students have no way to see where graduates of specific careers end up; lack of role models and success stories.
gaps.why_now: LinkedIn penetration is low in Peru; no localized platform tracks career outcomes for Peruvian graduates.
gaps.evidence_needed: Feasibility study on data collection from universities; user demand for alumni insights.
gaps.risk: Data privacy issues; difficulty in getting universities to share data.

gaps.title: Gamified career exploration for younger students
gaps.pain: High school students find career planning boring; early exposure can prevent later mismatches.
gaps.why_now: No engaging, game-like tool exists for Peruvian teens; existing tests are text-heavy and unappealing.
gaps.evidence_needed: A/B test of gamified vs. standard interface; engagement metrics from prototype.
gaps.risk: Development cost; may not appeal to all age groups.

gaps.title: Parent and family involvement in career decisions
gaps.pain: Family advice is the most common source, but often outdated or biased; parents lack reliable data to guide children.
gaps.why_now: No tool targets parents as a secondary audience; they influence decisions but have no access to labor market insights.
gaps.evidence_needed: Survey of parents' information sources; prototype testing with parent-student pairs.
gaps.risk: Privacy concerns; need to balance student autonomy with parental input.

checkpoint_instruction: Validate gap 1 by conducting a survey of 200+ Peruvian high school students to confirm that lack of labor market data is a top pain point. Also, prototype a minimal conversational agent that shows salary and employability for 5 careers and test with 20 users to measure engagement and perceived value.
